newsitem.title: JAPAN: INSIGHT -JGBs seen weaker on rises in Tokyo stocks.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -JGBs seen weaker on rises in Tokyo stocks.

text.p: FUTURE RANGE/DAY SPPRT RSTNC RSI-9 MA-5 MA-25
OUTLOOK OF BOJ OPERATION AT 0020 GMT: drainage of 200 bln yen
*Key June 10-year Japanese government bond (JGB) futures are likely to ease on Tuesday as Tokyo stocks are expected to rise toward 20,000 after three-day holiday weekend.
*June's topside is seen capped as recovery last week from recent low of 124.69 may be disturbed by rises in stock market. Support points lie at 125.15, followed by 125.00.
